xs_mom_p1.universe_rule: PIT daily eligibility: USDT-M perp with kline on day D, first kline <= D-30, 30d median quote-volume >= 5000000 USD; rank by 30d median quote-volume, keep top 100; snapshot at each weekly rebalance (Monday close) using data <= that close
xs_mom_p1.portfolio_rule: EW long-only top-K by momentum at Monday close, held to next Monday close; returns accrue from the bar AFTER the decision bar; momentum = sum of daily log-returns over L days ending S days before the decision close; costs 10bps per side on turnover; benchmark = EW full eligible universe, same mechanics
xs_mom_p1.placebo: N=500 within-rebalance random rank permutations of the momentum scores, identical mechanics; p=(1+#{placebo SR >= real SR})/(N+1)

dev_select.tiebreak: highest DSR, then lowest placebo p

fg_beta_d1.beta_rule: rolling 90d OLS beta of coin daily log-return on delta F&G (value diff), min 60 overlapping obs, inputs shift(1)-causal at the decision close
fg_beta_d1.grid_desc: exactly 2 configs: (a) standalone = EW long the MIDDLE F&G-beta quintile of the eligible universe, weekly, same mechanics/costs as P1; (b) overlay = P1 dev-selected portfolio excluding coins in the extreme (top+bottom) beta quintiles; if P1 selects NONE, only (a) runs

carry_go.note: stressed = after execution-realism cost pass C2 haircuts

axis_experiments.adopt_rule: delta_sharpe > 0 AND p_pos >= 0.85 (paired block bootstrap, block=21, n=2000) AND max_drawdown_worsening <= 0.01
axis_experiments.note: applies to axes: target, horizons, pool, features, sizing components

ml_survival.dsr_trials: trial_count() from ledger at evaluation time

stress_ews.episode_rule: crash day t: 10-day forward log-return of EW BTC+ETH close <= log(0.85); episode = maximal run of crash days, episodes separated by <10 non-crash days are merged; episode_start = first crash day
stress_ews.warn_rule: composite = mean(component z-scores, all lagged 1 day, z over trailing 365d window with min 180d); WARN active while composite >= k, released below k-0.25; components and k from grid

dev_select.tiebreak: lowest placebo_p, then most negative overlay_delta_maxdd

trend_wide_t1.signal: frozen metalabel primary verbatim (MA 5/20,10/40,20/60 + Donchian 20/10, vote>0.5, warmup 60); long-flat
trend_wide_t1.universe_rule: PIT monthly refresh at first Monday close of each month using data <= that close: USDT-M perp with kline on day D, first kline <= D-30, 30d median quote-volume >= 5000000 USD, rank by 30d median quote-volume, keep top-N; symbol needs >= 90 daily bars at decision; coin leaving universe force-flattened next bar with cost
trend_wide_t1.portfolio_rule: daily decision close t -> weights apply bar t+1; w = (1/N)*min(1, vol_target/(sigma30*sqrt(365)))*1{vote>0.5}; sigma30 = rolling 30-calendar-day std of daily log-returns, gapless else weight 0; costs 10 bps per side on sum|dW| charged first accrual day; missing kline contributes 0, no redistribution
trend_wide_t1.benchmark: per-N EW buy-and-hold of same monthly top-N universe, same t+1 and cost mechanics
trend_wide_t1.placebo: TWO families, 500 draws each, costs re-applied, p=(1+#{placebo SR >= real SR})/(N+1), gate on the WORSE (max) p: (a) per-coin independent circular time-shifts (min offset 30d) of the final daily weight series; (b) shared-offset circular time-shift (one offset for all columns per draw). Amended 2026-07-28 pre-registration after task-3 review (cross-coin co-activation caveat).

dev_select.tiebreak: highest DSR, then lowest placebo p

carry_xs_t1.signal: trailing mean over L days of daily funding income, daily funding = SUM of the UTC day's prints; realized prints only; rank cross-sectionally within monthly universe; signal NaN if any of trailing L days missing
carry_xs_t1.universe_rule: PIT monthly refresh at first Monday close: USDT-M perp with kline on day D, first kline <= D-30, 30d median quote-volume >= 5000000 USD, rank by volume, keep top-50; symbol additionally needs 30 gapless trailing funding days at decision else excluded that day; leaving symbol force-flattened next bar with cost
carry_xs_t1.portfolio_rule: daily decision close t -> weights bar t+1; valid = universe members with non-NaN signal and 30 gapless funding days; if n_valid < 5 flat; n_leg = max(1, round(leg_frac*n_valid)); SHORT top n_leg by (signal desc, symbol asc) at -0.5/n_leg, LONG bottom n_leg by (signal asc, symbol asc) EXCLUDING short-leg members at +0.5/n_leg; gross 1.0 net 0; costs 10 bps per side on sum|dW| first accrual day; funding accrual signed W*F (long pays positive funding); rf_daily = 1.045^(1/365)-1 deducted every day on full capital (house carry-audit convention, harshest-honest per section-41 mandate)
carry_xs_t1.benchmark: none (dollar-neutral; cash benchmark embedded via rf deduction)
carry_xs_t1.funding_coverage_note: 799/799 symbols fetched (2.406M prints); 0 missing; median day-coverage 1.001; 0 symbols below 90%; delisted perps confirmed to serve full funding history via /fapi/v1/fundingRate
carry_xs_t1.placebo: TWO families, 500 draws each, funding accrual AND costs AND rf re-applied to shifted weights, p=(1+#{placebo SR >= real SR})/(N+1), gate on the WORSE (max) p: (a) per-coin independent circular time-shifts (min offset 30d) of the final daily weight series; (b) shared-offset circular time-shift

dev_select.tiebreak: highest DSR, then lowest placebo p
